items.note: The Python tools are described as an internal tool used by four colleagues, not as production software or data services.
The cover letter explicitly says the experience is 'rather than a cloud data platform'; no cloud platforms are claimed.
Airflow, dbt, Spark and Kafka are not mentioned in either document.
The CV says the staging table was IT-created, and no data modelling or schema design is claimed.
The CV states the Docker Compose use was a tutorial, which is honest wording.
CI/CD is not mentioned in either document.
No automated testing of code is claimed; the 'checks' refer to test-rig data against specifications.
The Flask API is described as a personal learning project on a laptop, not a production REST API.
The CV says he adjusted setpoints and timers under the automation engineer's supervision, which does not claim PLC programming.
The CV says the course is 'in progress' and no certification is claimed.
